title: Ngo-2020-sleep-10.7554/elife.57011
description: Whole-night sleep recordings from 14 pre-surgical epilepsy patients, comprising a posterior hippocampal depth contact and scalp Cz at 1 kHz, totaling 135.6 hours. The derivative dataset repackages the authors' OSF release and includes sleep stage scoring, artifact intervals, and detected ripples and spindles. It supports investigation of hippocampal-neocortical coupling during sleep and memory consolidation.
methods_description: Two channels per patient were recorded overnight at 1 kHz: a hippocampal depth contact in the non-pathological hemisphere and scalp electrode Cz. Both were referenced to linked mastoids with a hardware band-pass of 0.01-300 Hz. Sleep was scored per Rechtschaffen & Kales criteria, and ripples, spindles and artifacts were detected with the authors' automated detectors. The released FieldTrip structures were converted to BrainVision float32 format.
